'''Namada''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was part of the [[Special Tactics Group 41-Delta]], also known as Bughunter Division. The unit was dispatched against hostiles insectoids on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they battled [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] and [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] respectively.
